contexts.text: Like the land of Egypt in coming to Zoar () = scientifics from the affections of good... For Zoar = the affection of good.

Zoar was a city not far from Sodom, to which Lot fled... and besides Zoar is mentioned in ; ; ; , where also it = affection. And, as it = the affection of good, in the opposite sense, it = the affection of evil.
The king of Bela, this is Zoar () = (a kind) of cupidity of evil and persuasion of falsity.

(This city) is a little one () = a little of truth. Explained. e, Zoar, in the Original Language, means little. For it here treats of those who are in the affection of truth, and not so much in the affection of good.
(Zoar) was situated at the foot of the mountain; and Lot afterwards went from it up the mountain. Explained.
I will not overthrow the city (Zoar) () = that the man in whom there is truth that has good within it shall not perish. Explained. AC 2437.

Therefore he called the name of the city Zoar () = the affection of truth... For they who are in the affection of truth have little of truth, because they have little of good as compared with those in the affection of good.
Lot came unto Zoar () = that those who are in the affection of truth are saved; for Zoar = the affection of truth.
Lot went up out of Zoar () = when they were no longer in the affection of truth... because all the good of truth had been vastated.

For he feared to dwell in Zoar () = because he could no longer, from the affection of truth, look to good. Zoar = the affection of truth, and when this has been vastated, it is impossible to look to good any longer.
